host.description: The agents of this conversation run commands as you on {host}, and can make it where this conversation runs.

credentials_manage.description: Manage Credentials lets the agents of this conversation remove your saved credentials. Your credentials serve every conversation you allow them in.

providers_manage.description: Add, change and remove your provider entries and their models, which every conversation of yours can use.

conversation_read.description: Read Your Other Conversations lets the agents of this conversation list your conversations and read what any of them holds. What they read goes to this conversation’s model provider.

agent_profiles.description: Create, edit and delete the subagent profiles every conversation of yours can use.

agent_workflow.description: Choose the workflow this conversation works with, as the composer’s Workflow menu does.

notificationsCard.title: The agent can’t notify you
notificationsCard.body: None of your browsers has notifications on. Turn them on to hear when the agent finishes or needs you, even with Demi closed.
notificationsCard.blocked: Notifications are blocked in this browser’s site settings.
